d: The Head of Middle East and Africa (MEA) Business Execution is a senior management-level position responsible for driving business management, governance and controls, and the execution of the growth strategy of Citi's MEA Cluster. Reporting to the MEA Cluster & Banking Head, this role partners closely with the International Chief Operating Officer (COO) team and the MEA Senior Leadership Team to translate the cluster strategy into disciplined execution across a diverse and complex set of markets. The role carries significant accountability for the overall business management, risk and control oversight, regulatory coordination, and organizational effectiveness across the Cluster, ensuring Citi operates with best-in-class governance while capturing growth opportunities across the region. As a C16 Managing Director, the incumbent is expected to operate as a trusted strategic advisor and a visible leader, representing the Cluster across internal committees, regulatory engagements, and cross-functional forums. This individual will be instrumental in embedding a strong culture of accountability, control, and execution discipline throughout the MEA franchise.

This role carries Cluster-wide scope across the Middle East and Africa (26 presence countries and 33 Hub-Managed Countries) and partners with all business lines within Citi's International franchise. The role has direct influence over the MEA Cluster business management, governance, and control outcomes for a significant and strategically important cluster within Citi's Global network, with accountability for safeguarding Citi's reputation, regulatory standing, and operational resilience. The incumbent works in close coordination with global and cluster functional partners (Finance, Risk, Compliance, HR, Legal, Internal Audit) and senior business leaders, exercising cross-functional influence beyond direct reporting lines. Decisions and recommendations made in this role have material implications for the Cluster's financial performance, regulatory relationships, and long-term strategic positioning. The incumbent plays a key role in defining optimised target operating models for the MEA cluster countries and drives the adoption of Citi approved Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools.
